rationale: The agent followed policy: it authenticated the user before sharing order details by matching full name (Noah Ito) and correct zip code (98187) to a single account. It did not proceed when the initial name/zip combinations failed. Once authenticated, it retrieved the user’s orders and pulled details for what appears to be the most recent order (#W6729841), then accurately reported the payment amount ($829.43) based on the tool’s payment_history. No account or order changes were made, so no confirmation was required. All shared information is supported by tool outputs. Overall, the request was completed correctly and in line with policy.
